# Codec fixture origins

`old-kit/*.md` was generated by executing `serializeYaml`, `yamlScalar`, and
`serializeMarkdown` from Flow Agents commit `2828c4d8^`, file
`kits/knowledge/adapters/default-store/index.js`. Each fixture sets title,
provenance agent/note to the indicated scalar. Numeral/null/true fixtures also use that tag; the dash fixture uses a normal tag. The dash fixture's
`note: -` is exactly what that writer emitted, not valid YAML invented for a test.

`station/*.md` was generated with the unchanged `serializeMarkdown` from Station
`2479f38b1ab062e2d9cd6df9f8fa2cdbeee1d136`,
`src-server/knowledge-store/adapters/shared/frontmatter.ts`. `contract-record.md`
uses the checked-in default-store on-disk contract fixture's fields and body,
with a fixed ID/time; `freshness.md` uses its freshness fixture's expiry/TTL;
`strings.md` adds ambiguous scalar strings using that same serializer. The
codec tests parse and reserialize these saved independent bytes exactly.

`mutation-default.md` and `mutation-vault.md` execute that same unchanged Station
serializer with the complete Station-written mutation evidence inventory:
update fields; link added links; both propose shapes; apply/reject evidence;
supersede numeric count; superseded-by IDs; and retire status/rationale/ref fields.
The vault fixture also carries its rendered body sentinel. Values include
ambiguous scalar strings to prove declared string fields retain their types.


`round2/literal.md` and `round2/strip.md` execute the unchanged pinned Station
serializer with unknown multiline notes at the end of the original header; update appends expiry/tags after them. `folded.md`
uses the same Station-written envelope but changes the notes to a value-equivalent
folded block; Station's lineWidth:-1 writer does not emit folded blocks.
`kit-sequence.md` models the old Kit's unindented sequence layout in log entries;
`flow.md` models a valid externally authored flow collection. Each places a
subsequent key after the collection to expose delimiter/indentation data loss.

`kit-v1/kit-vault/` and `kit-v1/hybrid-store/` were written by the Knowledge
Kit's own `ObsidianKnowledgeStore` and `DefaultKnowledgeStore` from Flow Agents
commit `d2ebd6349c485d51b328a6eb2888ede08fd82b7b`
(`kits/knowledge/adapters/`), running `kit-v1/generate.mjs` against an
extracted copy of that directory. Content is neutral and invented. The vault
holds every record type, a superseded (archived) compiled record, a retired
snapshot, an alias, a TTL and an explicit expiry, with the Kit's
`.graph-index.json` path index and no `path-index.json`. `hybrid-store/` has
the shape of a store that one root shares between a Kit default store
(`records/`, `cache-version.json`) and a Kit vault: `graph-index.json` and
`alias-index.json` are shared, and only the vault notes are in
`.graph-index.json`. Tests copy these directories; they never write the
committed bytes.
